hero.title: Make Memories
hero.body: Private and small-group journeys across Ethiopia — from the rock-hewn churches of Lalibela to the Simien escarpment, the peoples of the Omo Valley and the lava lakes of the Danakil.

intro.title: Three thousand years of history, one extraordinary country
intro.body: Ethiopia is unlike anywhere else. More than eighty peoples with their own languages and traditions; a landscape that runs from the jagged peaks of the Simien Mountains to the Danakil Depression, more than a hundred metres below sea level; and in between, wildlife and plants found nowhere else on earth.
intro.img1: Painted ceiling of Debre Birhan Selassie, Gondar
intro.img2: Gelada baboon above the Simien escarpment

Activities.lede: Festivals and pilgrimages, coffee forests and community stays, trekking, rafting and volcano expeditions.

groupLedes.events-and-festivals: Ethiopia follows its own calendar, and its festivals — Christian, Muslim and traditional — fill the year with colour.
groupLedes.cultural-experience: Food, faith and community: the experiences that bring you closest to Ethiopian life.
groupLedes.nature-activities: Endemic wildlife, extraordinary birdlife, wild coffee forests and landscapes on a vast scale.
groupLedes.outdoor-activities: Trek the highlands, raft the rivers, explore caves and stand at the edge of an active volcano.
groupLedes.activities: Journeys for schools, universities and curious minds of every age.

Unesco.title: Ethiopia’s 12 UNESCO World Heritage Sites
Unesco.lede: Ancient kingdoms, medieval churches, walled cities, prehistoric valleys and two of Africa’s great mountain parks.
Unesco.intro1: Ethiopia has twelve properties on UNESCO’s World Heritage List — among the most of any country in Africa — spanning millions of years of human history and some of the continent’s most important landscapes.
Unesco.intro2: It is also one of the world’s great biodiversity hotspots, with dozens of endemic mammals and birds and around a thousand endemic plants, protected in more than twenty national parks and many more sanctuaries and reserves.
